title: ze_pokemon_johto
description:
ze_pokemon_johto by MSR / Bart

Only 1 stage, might add more in the future.

How to play:
Walk into a pokemon to start the battle, you have 30 seconds to defeat the pokemon or it will kill you.
All pokemons must be defeated in each area to unlock the path for the next area.
Map is made for either bizon or p90 weapon.

Thanks to:
Source2 ZE Discord
GFL ZE Community
Mapeadores
RSS

Map is made to be played on zombie escape servers, but it can be played offline singleplayer, you just need these commands:
sv_cheats 1
give_weapon_bizon or give_weapon_p90
sv_infinite_ammo 2
